title: A record Hazel made with Al Hirt and Pete Fountain
summary: Hazel describes a record under his name with Jumbo and Pete when they were struggling, and says Hirt plays real jazz.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: I do have I have one that I would like to hear you hear I don't know whether you've heard I've got a record that I made under my name was with Jumbo and and Pete both in the band hmm and at the time the both of them were working for Miller the killer they couldn't get a job playing music and now today look where they are and look where I am what year was that this is oh see not too long maybe 10 15 years ago no kidding about that yeah well yeah Zimmerman was was they were all working for Miller killer and then after that they went to work for the guy Levy down not where he is now but down one street pure 500 yeah yeah the pure 500 and then from then on they went on up things change don't they it shows you how things will change and more positive both of them but I don't think you've ever heard heard play real jazz mmm no he plays pretty good jazz on this you know a lot of people tell you heard can't play jazz but don't ever believe that because when I bring this record down I think you'll like all right
